description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Event Calender with the planned dates of Tariff Reviews and Adjustments dates for Information Publications and dates for Public Consultations (Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009)
categorisation: This gazette content involves the issuance of an event calendar for tariff reviews and adjustments by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under the authority of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009. This constitutes regulatory framework implementation and compliance requirements, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized categories.
